correctness.rationale: The code regenerates the Fano graph and all 24 matchings from definitions. Its exact 2201-face intact complex, each 1552-face edge-fault subcomplex and each 649-cell relative set are exhaustively enumerated. For every one of 21 edges all 43 acyclic Hasse Morse pairings are checked, with critical cells (1 in dimension 0, 7 in dimension 2) for the subcomplex and 9 in dimension 2 for the relative chain complex. Unit-incidence algebraic Morse cancellation yields integral relative H2=Z9 and no H3; the LES gives a primitive split H2 injection; a primitive degree matrix between two-sphere wedges yields the nine-sphere quotient by homotopy-cofiber invariance. Independent mod-two boundary reductions agree, but do not substitute for the integral argument.

value.rationale: A first-edge fault in the canonical cubic Fano incidence graph is a natural robustness test. The previously known intact sixteen-sphere homotopy type cannot determine how much topology survives a missing incidence. The uniform seven-to-sixteen primitive integral map and nine-sphere cofiber are substantive inclusion-map information beyond rank enumeration, fully classifying every single-edge fault; no broader paper-sized theorem is necessary to motivate this precise discrete classification.
